contexts.text: Then all the man's thoughts and ideas, and even his words and actions, in which there is what is celestial and spiritual, are open, and lie open even from the Lord.
Their eyes were opened () = a dictate from within. Illustrated.
Except by one whose interior senses have been opened.
If the (spiritual) sight were only opened to anyone...
The Lord so appeared to them because their interior sight was opened.
As soon as anyone's interior sight is opened... AC 1619.
It is perceived whether the idea of their speech is closed, or open.
One who has the interior organs of hearing opened...
Shown by this: that the ideas of thought were opened. Explained.
The things which thus appear visible can be opened again...
When the interior sight was first opened to me...
The sight of my spirit has rarely been opened to me so far (as to the Heaven of Angels).
(In prayer) there is a certain opening of the man's interiors towards God...
It was perceived that the interiors of (these simple Spirits) could be opened.
The internal man has been opened towards Heaven...
That goods and truths have Power to close and to open Heaven...
Still, these things must be opened.
When the Lord opens man's internal sight...
His interiors are then open towards Heaven.
The communication with the interior man has not yet been opened.

From childhood to adolescence the communication to the interior Natural is opened... From adolescence to young manhood the communication between the Natural and the Rational is opened... and in proportion as he then imbues goods through truths... the Rational is opened; but in proportion as he (does not do this), the Rational is not opened...
The falsities and evils with man are opened by means of temptations... When they are opened, that mistiness appears...
Joseph opened all in which () = communication from remains. To open, here, = to communicate.
One opened his sack () = observation... That to open it = to observe, is evident from the series...

It is these scientifics which... open the way to the interiors; for... the external sensuous things are first opened, and then the interior sensuous things, and finally the intellectual things; and, when the intellectual things have been opened, they are represented in the former...
When... we had opened our wallets () = introspection into the exterior Natural... To open = introspection; for he who opens, does so for the sake of introspection.
There appeared a great square aperture... In the deep there was seen a round aperture, which was then open, but presently was closed...
For many reasons the sight of this eye is not opened to man...
The Hell which is in such evil is then opened.
The ideas were then open...
The ideas of my thought were then opened towards Heaven...
In proportion as his thought is more opened towards Heaven...
The quality of the idea of thought when closed, and when open. Described.
The Angels want their minds to be open...
With many of them this communication (with Heaven) was open; but with those who had not lived in the good of charity... there was sometimes open communication with evil Spirits.
The interiors of my spirit have been opened to me...
She opened it, and saw the child () = investigation into its nature...
When these Hells are opened...
The interiors of those who receive, are open to Heaven.
The opening of every womb () = that which is from charity. Explained. AC 8074. AC 8088.
The Hells were then for the most part open...
When a temptation is finished, communication is opened with Heaven.
Hence, with the regenerate, there is what is open even from the Lord...
Everything done according to Divine order is open within even to the Lord...
With those in good and thence in the affection of truth, the Intellectual of the mind is open into Heaven; and their soul... is in consort with the Angels.
With the Angels, all things of their discourse are open even to the Lord.
When they are not in the good of charity, the internal man is not open; for good is what opens it.
Hence the internal man cannot be opened...
When a man shall have opened a pit () = if anyone shall have received what is false from another... To open, when predicated of falsity, = to receive, here, from another...
The internal man with those in evil and falsity is closed above, and open below...
The Intellectual is then closed above, and is opened below; that is, it... is opened to Hell.
When the internal has been opened by regeneration, good from the Lord inflows through it...
A present blinds the open in eyes () = that gains cause truths not to appear. Explained, Illustrated.

The externals are opened by the things of the world; and the internals by the things of Heaven. There are two things which are thus opened; intellectual things and voluntary things; intellectual things are opened by the things which relate to truth, and voluntary things by those which relate to good... Hence it is evident what those things are which open the life of man. Further explained.
In proportion as he is not carried away by these delights, this (new Voluntary) is opened.
This Voluntary is closed above, and open below; that is... is open to the world.

These degrees of life are opened successively. Explained... These are the means through which are successively opened these three degrees of life with man; thus the three Heavens with him... As the good of life opens them, so the evil of life closes them... And as the Heavens are successively opened with man according to the good of his life... with some the First Heaven is opened and not the Second; with some the Second Heaven is opened and not the Third; and with those only who are in the good of life from love to the Lord is the Third Heaven opened.

In proportion as man thinks and wills from Heaven... his internal man is opened. The opening is to Heaven, even to the Lord Himself. (But) in proportion as man thinks and wills from the world... the internal man is closed, and the external is opened. The opening is to the world, and to self.
So long as man is merely natural, his interiors... are closed, and his exteriors... are opened... But when man becomes spiritual, his interiors... are opened...
When man suffers himself to be elevated by the Lord, Heaven is opened with him...

(This state of intelligence) does not exist until the interiors are opened towards Heaven... Man becomes intelligent and wise in proportion as the interiors are open; and they are opened in proportion as he lives to Heaven and not to the world.
The ascription of all things to the Lord opens the interiors of man towards Heaven...
The Word is that which opens Heaven.
Therefore, unless man is in good, his internal man is not opened... As Heaven is in the internal man, when this is opened the man is in Heaven.
With those in the good of love and truths of faith, the internal man is open...
When there is an aperture to Hell. Signified, Explained.
Every Hell... is opened above according to the necessity and need: this Opening is into the World of Spirits. Explained.
The man with whom the Internal has been opened perceives the Word spiritually; but does not know this while he lives in the world...

The Church cannot be instituted with any people, unless their interiors have been opened... and the interiors are not open, except with those who are in truths of faith from the good of life from the Lord. But with this people the interiors could not be opened... These are the things which close the interiors towards Heaven, and open them towards Hell.
For the internal man is opened and given to man through temptations. Explained.
When their external memory is opened by the Lord... But it is not opened except with the Lord's good pleasure.
The interior sight is then opened to the inhabitants...

The more open to the Lord the interiors are, the more interior is the Heaven in which they are... Those with whom the third degree is open are in the Inmost Heaven; (and so on). The interiors are opened by the reception of Divine good and Divine truth...
When the sight of his spirit is opened...
Open his eyes that he may see; and Jehovah opened the eyes of the young man (). AR 365.
Such things were seen by them when Heaven was open to them; and Heaven is said to be opened, when the interior sight is opened... and, when it pleases the Lord, the eyes of the spirit are opened...

With those in the Inmost Heaven, the third degree is opened, and the second and first are closed; with those in the Middle Heaven, the second degree is open, and the first and third closed; and with those in the Ultimate Heaven, the first degree is open, and the second and third closed...

To speak with Angels is granted to those alone with whom the interiors have been opened through Divine truths even to the Lord... The reason Divine truths open the interiors of man, is... The internal man is not opened except through the Divine truth...
The reason the Angels can receive such great wisdom, is that their interiors are open...
Those with whom the first degree has been opened, are in the First Heaven; (and so on).
When the internal of man has not been opened above, but only below...
By which the interiors (of the infants) are opened...
Thus, and no otherwise, are the interiors of man opened.
The wise of this kind are those whose interiors are not only open, but also cultivated...
The interiors of these have not been opened except from below...
In proportion as these two loves of Heaven are received... the interiors are opened... But in proportion as these two loves of the world are received... the exteriors are opened...
When they come to their own Society, their interiors are opened...
In proportion as man is conjoined with Heaven, the higher things of his mind are opened; and, in proportion as these are opened, he...
At their apertures, which are called the gates of Hell, appears a monster...
When the Hells are opened, there appears...
The apertures, or gates, to the Hells, which are beneath the mountains, hills, and rocks, appear like holes and fissures... Described. HH 585.

So long as man does not shun evils as sins, the concupiscences of evils... are like a black cloud beneath the spiritual mind, and prevent its being opened. But as soon as man shuns evils as sins, the Lord inflows from Heaven, and... opens the spiritual mind; and thus intromits the man into Heaven.

He is elevated into the heat and light of Heaven, which is effected by the interiors being opened; and, when these are opened, love and wisdom inflow into the interiors of the mind, and the heat and light of Heaven into the interiors of the body...
Their mind is closed above, and opened below...
Through the opening of the interior degrees of his mind...
That these three degrees of height... can be successively opened; and, as they are opened, the man is in the Lord, and the Lord in him. Explained.

Nevertheless, the second degree... is not opened thereby; this one is opened by the love of uses... But still the third degree is not opened by these; but this one is opened by the celestial love of use...
In the world, man knows nothing of the opening of these degrees...
When he dies, he comes into that degree which has been opened in the world...
For by the opening of these faculties man comes into the higher degrees...
Still, these forms are not opened until spiritual heat conjoins itself with spiritual light... by this conjunction these transparent forms are opened...
The light of winter does not open anything...
By the love of good and its heat a higher degree is opened: for the Lord inflows from above, and opens it...
That if the higher degree is not opened, the man becomes natural... Explained.

The natural degree is first opened; and afterwards, if he shuns evils as sins, and looks to the Lord, the spiritual degree is opened; and finally the celestial one. As these three degrees are successively opened... it follows that the two higher degrees may not be opened...
It is not known that a natural man becomes spiritual by the opening of any higher degree, and that the opening is effected by a spiritual life...
The quality of the natural man with whom the spiritual degree has been opened. Explained.
The quality of the natural man with whom the spiritual degree has not been opened, but still is not closed. Explained.

For the spiritual degree is opened through the conjunction of love and wisdom... If, therefore, genuine truths... are not known, love does not avail to open this degree, but only keeps it in the potency of being opened; which is meant by its not being closed...
That... if the higher degrees are not opened, the natural mind acts against them; but if they are opened, it acts with them. Explained. DLW 263.
These three degrees are neither opened nor closed in... early infancy.
These degrees are opened with man according to his life; in the world actually but not perceptibly...
That man himself must open the doors, is evident from... if anyone will open the door, I will come in to him... ().
These are the degrees which are opened with man according to the conjunction; they are opened according to the love...
For the Lord alone opens the spiritual and the celestial degree; but only with those who are wise from Him.
For felicities are exalted... as the higher degrees of the mind are opened.
When man desists from evils, the door is opened...
Then the Lord opens the spiritual mind...
Like a wound, which is not healed unless it is opened.
Their understanding is... open only below...
Thus have (these receptacles) been closed above, and opened below... when yet from creation they were open in front and closed behind...
This is effected by the opening of the sight of man's spirit.
For the goods of life open the interiors of the mind; and, when these have been opened, truths appear in their own light.
Who openeth and no one closeth, and closeth and no one openeth () = who alone is omnipotent to save. Explained. Compare AE 206.
I have set before thee an open door () = that Heaven has been opened to those who are in truths from good... AE 208.
To open the door () = to live according to the Divine truth.
A little book open () = the Word as to the following doctrine therein...
The temple of God was opened in Heaven... ()... By opened is signified that the Divine Human and the decalogue... are now seen.
The power of opening and closing Heaven. Explained. AR 840. Signified, Explained.
I saw Heaven open () = revelation from the Lord, and manifestation then.
Approach, and your eyes will be opened, and you will see the garden...
The eyes of their spirits were opened (when they saw Angels, and the Lord after His resurrection).
No Angel or infernal can speak with man unless he has the interiors of his mind opened...
That two consorts are this form... in proportion as the interiors of their minds have been opened. (Explained.)
With some the mind is not closed, but remains half-open above; and, with some, open.

Hence love truly conjugial opens the interiors of the minds, as it opens the interiors of the senses; and, with these, the organics of the whole body... A man is wise in proportion as the interiors of his mind are opened; for by the opening the thoughts... are elevated into higher light, and the affections... into higher heat.
Then, suddenly, the earth opened... CL 264.
In the primeval state of man all the interiors of the mind were open even to the Lord...

These regions (of the mind) are opened successively; the ultimate region... from infancy to childhood, by knowledges; the second region... from childhood to adolescence, by thoughts from knowledges; and the highest region... from adolescence to young manhood, and further, by perceptions of Truths...
There was a great aperture in the middle of the roof (of the temple).
The Angels closed the externals of their minds, and opened their internals...
So that the understanding is opened above more and more.
Falsities close the understanding, and Truths open it.
That the Lord... opens Heaven to those who approach the Holy Supper worthily... General article.
In His glorified Human the Lord cannot appear to any man, unless He first opens the eyes of his spirit; and these cannot be opened with him who is in evils and the derivative falsities.
The Lord has opened the sight of my spirit...
A lucidity appearing through apertures...
With those in love truly conjugial, the interiors are opened...
Thrust down into Hell through apertures...
A long aperture there, which stretches under the earth.
Thus is opened the internal spiritual man... DLove 17:5.
To open the door () = reception into the heart, or life. Explained.
What is meant by man's opening the door.
[260a]. A door opened in Heaven () = arcana of Heaven revealed.
To open the hand () = to gift with good.
To open the book and loose its seals () = to know and perceive the states of life of all.
To open the seal () = to reveal hidden things.
He opened the pit of the abyss () = communication and conjunction with the Hells...
With every man the interiors... are opened successively. Explained.
A little book open = the Word manifested. AE 615.
When homogeneous things... approach the spiritual mind, it opens itself. Explained.
But the third degree is opened with those who at once apply Divine truths to life...
As they are in truths from good, so is the internal spiritual man opened with them...
After birth, the sensuous mind is first opened; then the natural mind; and, as he studies intelligence, the rational mind; and, as he studies wisdom, the spiritual mind.
The eyes of their spirits were opened (when, after His resurrection, they saw) the Lord as to the body which He had had in the world.
The heat of this sun (merely) opens the extremes of the body...
